Metadata.title: MONEX Academy — Where money is made.
Metadata.description: Find a business idea that fits your budget and skills, build your team, learn what you're missing and start earning.

Footer.tagline: The global platform for finding business ideas with real numbers, the people to build them, and the skills to launch.
Footer.disclaimer: Earnings figures shown on ideas are estimates by their authors, not guarantees.

Home.title: Where money is made.

Terms.mvp: Minimum viable product: the simplest version of a product that lets you test demand with real customers.
Terms.margin: The share of revenue left after direct costs. A 40% margin means $40 profit on every $100 of sales.
Terms.unitEconomics: Revenue and costs measured per single unit (one customer or one sale), to check whether each sale is profitable.

account.title: Choose your username

intents.body: Choose everything that applies. You can change this later.

budget.body: We'll show ideas that fit your budget.

mode.title: Online, in person or both?
mode.body: Where would you like to work?

team.title: Solo or with a team?
team.body: Some ideas work best alone, others need partners.

time.title: How much time do you have each week?
time.body: Be realistic. It helps us suggest the right ideas.

interests.title: Your interests and skills
interests.body: Pick the categories you like and the skills you already have.
